fact: As of early 2026, 14,276 Abidjan streets were officially named, 290,805 occupancy-unit plates installed (95%), and the inland-city project PAVI extends addressing to Yamoussoukro, Bouaké, Korhogo and Daloa, targeting 15 regional hubs by 2030.
title: Adressage des rues en Côte d'Ivoire : la ville prend enfin un nom et un numéro
